name: Finances
overview: Scripture teaches that financial stewardship requires wisdom, contentment, and responsibility. Believers are cautioned against debt, recognizing that the borrower becomes servant to the lender, and are encouraged to give generously, trusting that God will provide abundantly in return. Christians are called to avoid covetousness and to be content with what they have, relying on God's promise never to forsake them. Ultimately, love fulfills the law in all financial dealings, emphasizing integrity and care in managing resources.
